Participants: [Alex](/note/people/alex_morgan), [Jamie](/note/people/jamie_chen),
[Maya](/note/people/maya_singh), and [Noah](/note/people/noah_williams).

## Decisions

- Use “signals” rather than ratings.
- Keep consent visible in the working dataset and export.
- Treat the graph as an exploration surface, not an org chart.
- Test the prototype at [the open studio](/note/events/2026/atlas_open_studio).

## Open questions

1. Can a visual legend leave enough room for serendipity?
2. Which parts of the [conversation kit](/note/notes/interview_kit) are too formal?
3. How should we show disagreement without implying an error?

The team agreed to revisit [Design principles](/note/notes/design_principles) after
the first interview synthesis.

occurrences.context: Her working rules live in Design principles, and her open questions are captured in August studio notes.
